text: The double spending problem has not been eradicated in theory: a group or syndicate obtaining 51 percent control of a network could reverse transactions and create a private chain that the market could only limitedly discern as not real.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
abstract: There is the possibility a group or syndicate could gain 51% control over the network and would therefore be able to reverse transactions and create a private blockchain, which the market could only limitedly discern as not real.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: a decentralized network where one party can amass majority hashing control
